infra-bot: Alert: smtp-outbound route3 bounce rate spike 2024-09-10T11:02Z.

```
2024-09-10T10:58:12Z ERROR mailer route3 550 5.1.1 recipient unknown to=eng@50xlabs.com org=50x-staging
```

carla.cs: Okay - treat as renewal-watch. Immediate asks: a) temporary unblock so they can onboard; b) a clear customer message + ETA.

ben.csm: I can offer a manual onboarding session tomorrow 9am PT and share one-time setup links. Prefer engineered fallback first.

maria.engineer: Fastest is to generate one-time onboarding tokens and reissue links (ETA 10m). Longer fix: enable partner-smtp routing for 50x org (ETA ~40m) pending legal email sender note.

carla.cs: Do both. Ben, take tokens now and run the enablement tomorrow. Nina, document token links in ticket and mark impacted users. I'll draft comms: apology, we've issued one-time links and enabling backup route; invite to 9am PT session.

nina.support: Tokens created for 12 users and posted to ticket #57120. Command used: `create_token --org=50x-staging --users=file`

infra-bot: Partner route ready: send tests show 6/6 deliveries at 2024-09-10T11:27Z. Sender domain will show as @mail-partner.redwood.com. Legal cleared under existing clause.

ben.csm: Sent comms, customer accepted 9am PT. I'll run enablement and confirm SSO + first-run.

carla.cs: Recap actions: ben run enablement; maria monitor partner route and report bounces; nina close ticket after enablement; carla to write short internal note for onboarding playbook. Flag remains renewal-watch until pilot start.

nina.support: Acknowledged, updating ticket.

carla.cs: Thanks team 5 raised_hands:
